data.exact_reserve_text: Total outstanding claims, gross of reinsurance, were $250.4 million at 31 December 2019 (2018: $362.2 million).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 780's gross claims outstanding decreased from $362.2m at 31-Dec-2018 to $250.4m at 31-Dec-2019. The movement reflects a material prior-year release (reported as approximately $83.3m) driven by favourable claims development and claim settlements across the portfolio.
raw_causal_phrases: Total outstanding claims, gross of reinsurance, were $250.4 million at 31 December 2019 (2018: $362.2 million).
data.data_quality_notes: Many figures were taken from narrative and summary tables in scanned pages. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from narrative/technical provisions totals (2018 comparative). Prior year development amount ($83.3m release) inferred from narrative references rather than a clearly labeled gross 'movement in prior year's provision' table; therefore treated as gross but with moderate confidence. Gross premium total taken from segmental/summary premium table (page 26) with moderate confidence. The claims development triangle is present in the report but individual cell values were not reliably OCR-extracted from scanned images; therefore triangle details are not fully captured here.
